correctness.rationale: Finite graph encoding is exactly the Fano incidence difference set {0,1,3}. By girth six every connected induced four-subgraph is a claw (14) or three-edge path (84), giving 903 disconnection facets. Every five-vertex induced forest contains a disconnected induced four-subset, giving the full eight-skeleton and 15816 faces. The embedded complete bitset verifier constructs all 15816 faces and 108416 Hasse covers, matches by successive vertex toggles, counts precisely 188 critical nine-faces and no other critical face, and independently topologically sorts all directed covers. Complete topological-sort count 15816 proves acyclicity; Forman discrete Morse theory yields the wedge of 188 nine-spheres. A separate face-by-face mod-two boundary-rank calculation confirms only Betti_9=188. No sampling or extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical point-line incidence graph of the Fano plane, with high symmetry and girth six; ordinary four-cut is a natural next parameter for an established topological construction. The complete nontrivial integral homotopy type of its 903-facet, 14-vertex pure nine-dimensional complex is determined, not merely its Euler characteristic or mod-two Betti number. The exhaustive certified matching is reusable for checking the precise finite invariant. There is no claim of a general theorem, a shellability result, or an equivariant decomposition.
